source_surfaces: visible LinkedIn Posts All filters panel
visible LinkedIn post detail for text, image, video, document, link-card, poll, and repost variants
visible personal post composer and every account-visible nested creation dialog
visible post and comment composers, GIF picker, and six-option reaction tray

personal_post_creation_contract.composer_loader: a bounded visible loading dialog may precede the named composer
personal_post_creation_contract.unchanged_settings: Save and Done stay disabled; Back returns to the composer

engagement_contract.discussion_alias_behavior: activity post URLs may expose native ugc-post comment references
engagement_contract.current_thread_layout: root comments and replies are sibling regions; visible reply indentation binds each reply to the nearest preceding root
engagement_contract.current_comment_author: the actor-description link contains name, an optional Author badge, then the actual headline

search_card_selector: main article, main [role="listitem"]:has(button[aria-label^="Open control menu for post by "])

search_card_contract.header: one compact region containing the exact post-menu control, author identity, relationship or follower count, headline, and age
search_card_contract.body: [data-testid="expandable-text-box"] with bounded expansion through its visible button; keyboard activation is used when the text layer intercepts pointer input
search_card_contract.engagement: numeric text inside the exact Reaction button state, Comment, and Repost controls
search_card_contract.content_type: derive from bounded post content and link-card regions; exclude author avatars

detail_contract.exact_post_control: button[aria-label^="Open control menu for post by "]
detail_contract.reaction_state: [aria-label^="Reaction button state:"] inside one bounded reaction control
detail_contract.repost_behavior: The wrapper Copy link action resolves the original stable post reference; the original is read as a second bounded visible page.

notes: Synthetic identities and text preserve only current accessibility, section-scoped typeahead, submitted-parameter, result-card, stable-reference, dynamic card-text evidence, pagination, post-detail expansion, media, poll, engagement, composer-loading, unchanged-settings, and repost behavior represented by the current visible-UI contract. LinkedIn's current Content type control is single-choice; Images submits photos, Job posts submits jobs, and Live videos submits liveVideos. No real identity, content, raw DOM, cookie, credential, or browser state is retained.
